key_insight: OptScientist discovers compact symbolic optimization laws that explain observed behavior as the solution to an underlying optimization problem.
engineering_relevance: The framework could help engineers infer interpretable objectives and constraints from data rather than only fit input-output relationships.
method: Learn an optimization-based representation of observed data.
Extract a compact symbolic optimization problem.
Use an LLM agent to integrate literature priors, interpret candidate laws, and suggest new data collection.
evidence_signal: On the 99-problem OptFeynman benchmark, OptScientist recovers over 80% of ground-truth laws; human risky-choice and monetary-policy evaluations show competitive held-out prediction with few parameters.
watch_item: Predictive accuracy alone does not establish that a discovered objective or constraint is the true mechanism generating the data.
paper_title: OptScientist: Automated Discovery of Optimization Laws
